description: This Java class 'SessionedSignal' is part of the Eclipse Ditto project and provides a session-aware, signal-enrichment capable wrapper for Signal objects. It implements the SessionedJsonifiable interface, managing JSON serialization, headers, and enrichment retrieval within a streaming session context.

classes.name: SessionedSignal
classes.description: A session-aware, JSON-enrichable wrapper for the Signal class, supporting retrieval of extra fields via signal enrichment within a streaming session.

methods.name: getJsonifiable
methods.description: Returns the JSON serializable representation of the encapsulated signal.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the headers associated with the signal.

methods.name: retrieveExtraFields
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves additional JSON fields for the signal, optionally using a SignalEnrichmentFacade.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Provides optional access to the associated StreamingSession.
